result.title: Near-Zero Forgetting Is Not Enough: Out-of-Distribution Robustness in Continual Learning of Pretrained VLAs
result.comment: Presented at the CoRL 2026 Workshop on Robot Learning at Deployment (Learn@Deploy). Project page: https://adrrp.github.io/vla-ood-robustness
result.summary: Recent work shows that pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit near-zero forgetting in specific continual learning settings with experience replay. However, robustness to domain shift of learned tasks remains unexplored. In this work, we study the robustness of Pi0 fine-tuned with experience replay under out-of-distribution (OOD) data using the LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks. While the in-domain (ID) setup achieves near-zero catastrophic forgetting, OOD performance on previous tasks quickly collapses. Specifically, we show that during the continual learning process, the OOD capabilities of the model degrade, following a shared representational pattern across domain shifts, which is also visible behaviorally in the two simpler suites. Representational analysis shows that drift concentrates in the multimodal and action features. Linear probes indicate that OOD features still retain task-relevant information, but appear unreadable, consistent with representation misalignment. These findings suggest that even when ID stability remains intact, severe OOD forgetting can still occur, accompanied by representational drift during continual learning.

AI.brief_summary: 研究预训练 VLA 模型 Pi0 在 experience replay 持续学习下对 OOD 域偏移的鲁棒性：LIBERO/LIBERO-Plus 上 ID 遗忘接近零，但旧任务的 OOD 性能迅速崩溃；表征漂移集中于多模态与动作特征，线性探针显示 OOD 特征仍含任务相关信息却难以读出，符合表征错位。
AI.relevance_reason: 「信息仍在但不可读」的探针诊断可为 LVR 中视觉证据是否被保留却未被下游使用（信息坍缩、表征错位）提供可供核查的探测思路，但其对象是机器人动作持续学习，与推理期 latent 状态生成关系较远。
